data.desc: Boxlight Corporation (Nasdaq: BOXL) delivers integrated technology solutions that connect instruction, communication, and safety across education and professional settings. Its portfolio includes interactive displays, instructional software, classroom audio, curriculum solutions, campus communication, digital signage, and safety technologies that help organizations create more connected, effective, and secure spaces. Serving customers in more than one hundred countries, Boxlight delivers its solutions through brands including Clevertouch, FrontRow and Mimio, supported by a global network of certified reseller and integrator partners. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Duluth, Georgia, Boxlight is publicly traded on Nasdaq.
